description: This file defines an interface for a grain in an Orleans-based application, specifying methods for retrieving and adding names.

classes.name: IInitialStateGrain
classes.description: Interface for a grain that manages a list of names, extending the Orleans grain interface.

methods.name: GetNames
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the list of names stored in the grain.

methods.name: AddName
methods.description: Asynchronously adds a new name to the grain's list.
